name: Cassava Leaf Disease Classification Benchmark
description: The Cassava Leaf Disease dataset is an in-field crop pathology benchmark created by the Makerere University AI Lab in Uganda, the National Crops Resources Research Institute (NaCRRI), and the CVPR 2020 Fine-Grained Visual Categorization workshop. It contains 21,397 high-resolution digital photographs of cassava leaves (Manihot esculenta) taken by agricultural extension workers and smallholder farmers in rural Uganda using standard smartphones under unconstrained natural lighting. Each image is categorized by expert plant pathologists into one of five diagnostic categories: Cassava Bacterial Blight (CBB), Cassava Brown Streak Disease (CBSD), Cassava Green Mottle (CGM), Cassava Mosaic Disease (CMD), and Healthy.
